$comment: The server cvars, defined one time for the client and the server. The client embeds this file (game_console.zig) and the server reads it (server/console.ts). Every cvar here is a server cvar: the server owns it and clients only read it. The format: game/src/console/schema.zig. The server reads the values from server/server.cfg, then from the SV_<NAME> environment variables.

cvars.name: despawn_cadaver_timer
cvars.description: Seconds until a dead body despawns in deathmatch. Unset or negative: bodies never despawn.
cvars.reader: Nothing reads it yet. The ragdoll bodies will read it.

cvars.name: match_seconds
cvars.description: The length of a deathmatch match, in seconds. A change applies from the next match.

cvars.name: end_seconds
cvars.description: Seconds that the score board shows after a match. A change applies from the next match end.

cvars.name: admin_password
cvars.description: The password of remote admin (rcon). Empty: remote admin is off. It never goes to a client.
